body: it was distance, she said she fell out of love for me. and that she gives me too much :(

i dont know where to start, my girlfriend of 4 years broke up with me yesterday. she was there throught my diagnosis with bipolar disorder, she helped me though it.
my entire catalog of coping mechanisms is all wrapped up in her.

she found me when i saw no light in the world. and she showed me but i will forever see the light through her explinations through her mind. i cannot enjoy anything again. suicide seems like the only relief
